BrochureContent.Content:
DNG Brady is delighted to present this superb extended semi-detached residence to the market, ideally located in the highly sought-after Five Oaks Village, just off the Dublin Road on the south side of Drogheda.

Presented in excellent condition throughout, the well-appointed accommodation comprises an entrance hallway, a spacious sitting room, a newly fitted open-plan kitchen, dining and living area, guest WC, three bedrooms, including a main bedroom with en-suite, and a family bathroom.

Five Oaks Village is an increasingly popular residential location, offering a wide range of amenities within easy reach. The property is ideally positioned for commuters, with main and local bus routes located at the entrance to the development, Drogheda Train Station within a short walk, and convenient access to the M1 motorway.

This is an excellent opportunity to acquire a stylish, extended home in true walk-in condition within one of Drogheda's most desirable locations.

Viewing is highly recommended.
